name: "Lady Bug" Caprese Pizzettes with Basil Pesto, Fresh Mozzarella, Tomatoes & Olives

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Cut rounds in half and transfer to a plate.
Drain both kinds of olives. Halve the whole olives lengthwise, then add both kinds to the plate with the tomatoes. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup large black olives,  pitted
1 (3.8 oz) can sliced black olives

instructions.primary_message: Split English muffins in half and arrange on a large baking sheet pan.

Spread each muffin half with 1 tbsp pesto, then top with a mozzarella slice. Arrange tomatoes on top of the cheese, overlapping at the "head" of your "ladybug" so that there is a 1-inch triangular opening at the bottom, creating "wings."
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup basil pesto
1 (12 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place an olive half on each muffin, cut-side down, where the tomatoes overlap, creating the ladybug "head." Arrange sliced olives on the wings to create "spots."
Place baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Arrange ladybug pizzettes on a serving platter and enjoy!
